q: How many books are in the catalogue?
Which city has the most customers?
sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which genre sold the most copies?
sql: SELECT b.genre FROM orders o JOIN books b ON b.id = o.book_id GROUP BY b.genre ORDER BY SUM(o.qty) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average star rating across all reviews?
How many orders were placed in March 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE day LIKE '2026-03-%'

q: What is the most expensive book and its price?
sql: SELECT title, price_inr FROM books ORDER BY price_inr DESC LIMIT 1
